title: GTA V Wasted
blurb: Greyscale, slow motion, one word across the screen. Rockstar's death sting from Grand Theft Auto V lands as hard as it does because the game slows time first, giving you a moment to appreciate the mistake in full before the thud arrives. The meme format essentially wrote itself: apply it to any real-world faceplant, rejection or comprehensive defeat, with the desaturation filter strongly implied. No more cinematic way exists to announce that somebody has just been folded by life. A fail-compilation essential since 2013.
origin: The death/arrest sting from Grand Theft Auto V (Rockstar, 2013).
